lead_raw_text:
The structure of Ag₂SeO₄ crystallizes in the cubic space group F-43m (No. 216), with a 56-atom unit cell (Ag₁₆Se₈O₃₂) distributed over five independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-only CrystalNN analysis identifies Ag in two environments: one octahedral with six O neighbors and one tetrahedral with four O neighbors, while Se is tetrahedrally coordinated by four O atoms. Corner-sharing is observed between Ag tetrahedra, Ag octahedra, Ag and Se tetrahedra, and between Se tetrahedra. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 56 sites.
